title: 1.3 Creating Conscious Citizens and Sustainable Development
description: Environmental ethics, civic participation and the principles of sustainable development. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which term matches this description? Development that meets present needs without harming future generations
Which term matches this description? A person aware of social and environmental responsibilities
Which term matches this description? Moral principles guiding human conduct toward the natural world
Which term matches this description? Participation of citizens in community and public affairs
Which term matches this description? Learning that builds awareness of environmental issues
Which term matches this description? The collection, treatment and disposal of waste materials
Which term matches this description? Processing used materials so they can be made into new products
Which term matches this description? Decomposing organic waste into a nutrient-rich soil amendment
Which term matches this description? Stopping waste at its source instead of cleaning it later
Which term matches this description? The total greenhouse gases emitted by an activity or person
Which term matches this description? An economy that improves well-being while reducing environmental risk
Which term matches this description? Using goods and services in ways that limit environmental harm
Which term matches this description? Involvement of local people in decisions affecting their lives
Which term matches this description? Fair treatment of all people regarding environmental burdens
Which term matches this description? The extent to which people understand an issue and its causes
Which term matches this description? Activity aimed at influencing public policy and decisions
Which term matches this description? Unpaid work done to benefit the community or environment
Which term matches this description? Evaluating evidence and arguments before forming a judgment
Which term matches this description? Fairness in resource use between present and future generations
Which term matches this description? Understanding the ecological systems that sustain human life
